defs.def: to some degree 不与否定词连用

ex.s: The 21st century has created a whole range of new types of professionals that we have never had before — or if not quite new, at least newly repackaged.
ex.t: 21世纪创造了一系列我们以前从未有过的新类型专业人士——或者即使不算全新，至少也是被重新包装过的。

ex.s: Relearning the art of seeing the world around us is quite simple, although it takes practice and requires breaking some bad habits．
ex.t: 重新学习观察周围世界的艺术其实很简单，尽管需要练习，还需要改掉一些坏习惯。

defs.def: to the greatest possible degree 完全；十分；非常；彻底

ex.s: But even then, what he had wasn’t quite what he wanted.
ex.t: 直到1980年——在他职业生涯的第32年——他才在《空前绝后满天飞》中获得了那个似乎是为他量身定做的角色。

ex.s: Nobody is quite sure, but poor diet and above all long-time alcoholism have much to do with it.
ex.t: 没有人相当肯定，但糟糕的饮食，最重要的是长期酗酒与它有关。

ex.s: This is quite important, because it is directly related to your commitment.
ex.t: 这一点非常重要，因为它与你的投入程度直接相关。

defs.def: to a great degree; very; really 在很大程度上；很；的确

ex.s: His parents were not quite able to keep theirs under control.
ex.t: 他的父母不太能够控制住自己的情绪。

ex.s: The pronunciation system of the Chinese language is quite different from that of English.
ex.t: 汉语的语音系统与英语的语音系统大不相同。

ex.s: Cats have many heightened senses, but their sense of smell is quite impressive.
ex.t: 猫的许多感官都很敏锐，但它们的嗅觉尤其出色。

ex.s: Although landscapes in the Midwest tend to be quite similar, either farm fields or highways, sometimes I find distinctive character in the hills or lakes.
ex.t: 尽管中西部的风景往往大同小异，不是农田就是公路，但有时我会在丘陵或湖泊中发现独特的韵味。

ex.s: She is quite good at cooking.
ex.t: 她很擅长做饭。

ex.s: Worked quite well on me.
ex.t: 对我很有效果。

ex.s: It turns out that pet transporting pays quite well at about $30, 000 per year before tax.
ex.t: 事实证明宠物运输报酬相当可观，税前每年约30,000美元。

ex.s: She smiled at me and said if I needed help, she’d be right there, which I found quite comforting.
ex.t: 她对我微笑说如果需要帮助她就在那里，我觉得这很令人安慰。

ex.s: We                   quite enough work for the morning; now let's take a break.
ex.t: 我们上午的活___已经干得够多了；现在休息一下吧。

ex.s: The style of the campus is quite different from that of most Chinese universities.
ex.t: 将它们保存在博物馆中。

ex.s: They are quite expensive.
ex.t: 替换它们可能很困难。

ex.s: As cultural symbols go, the American car is quite young.
ex.t: 随着文化符号的发展，美国汽车相当年轻。

ex.s: As the generation to have grown up in the Information Age, they are quite confident when it comes to showing off their interests and skills in this field.
ex.t: 作为在信息时代长大的一代人，他们在展示自己在这一领域的兴趣和技能时相当自信。

ex.s: In his thirties, he was quite thin and pale, and he had red, bushy hair.
ex.t: 他三十多岁时相当瘦削苍白，有一头浓密的红发。

ex.s: It can be quite stressful at times, though, which in turn makes me feel anxious.
ex.t: 不过，有时它可能会相当紧张，这反过来又让我感到焦虑。

ex.s: It’s quite large.
ex.t: 它家具齐全。

ex.s: He must have been waiting there for quite a while!
ex.t: 他一定在那儿等了很久了！

ex.s: After the trip, my family became quite interested in camping.
ex.t: 这次旅行之后，我的家人对露营产生了浓厚的兴趣。

defs.def: a large amount of sth 大量；众多

ex.s: The experiment of estimation he conducted showed that in some cases, the average of a large number of independent estimates could be quite accurate.
ex.t: 他进行的估计实验表明，在某些情况下，大量独立估计的平均值可能相当准确。

ex.s: It’s jaw-dropping how much perfectly good food is thrown away — from “ugly” (but quite eatable) vegetables rejected by grocers to large amounts of uneaten dishes thrown into restaurant garbage cans.
ex.t: 完美完好的食物被扔掉的数量令人震惊——从杂货商拒绝的"丑陋"（但完全可以食用）的蔬菜到大量被扔进餐厅垃圾桶的剩菜。

ex.s: “Quite a lot,” Daru explained.
ex.t: 相当大，”Daru解释道。

ex.s: After struggling for quite a while, I made a difficult decision—leaving my job and studying my design course full time.
ex.t: 挣扎了相当一段时间后，我做了一个艰难的决定——辞职并全日制攻读设计课程。

ex.s: This style of farming lasted for quite a long time.
ex.t: 这种耕作方式持续了相当长的时间。

ex.s: My grandpa said last summer they earned quite a lot by sell the fish.
ex.t: 爷爷说去年夏天他们卖鱼赚了相当多钱。

ex.s: Dad has changed quite a bit!
ex.t: 爸爸变化可真大！

ex.s: Having seen quite a few productions of Hamlet and read the play many times, I was full of confidence - until the Peking Opera came to town!
ex.t: 看过不少版本的《哈姆雷特》演出，也多次读过剧本，我本来信心满满——直到京剧来到镇上！

ex.s: Having seen quite a few productions of Hamlet and read the play many times...
ex.t: 看过不少版本的《哈姆雷特》演出，也多次读过剧本……
